PCM-only subset of shazamio/shazamio-core, commit 3184590a91097f3b4fb62a2cdd247a932de154b5 (MIT).
Upstream: https://github.com/shazamio/shazamio-core
Algorithm, Hanning coefficients and signature serializer retained; file decoding, resampling, Python bindings and file-dependent algorithm tests removed. Signature serialization tests retained. The application supplies bounded 16 kHz mono PCM.
